edgarContact.description: Enter your name or organization and a reachable email address, for example Example Research research@example.com. SEC requires a declared requester for EDGAR requests. Leave blank to use market data tools without EDGAR.

thesis.description: Decision journal: record an investment thesis with cited metrics, list theses, or scan for thesis breaks

interface.shortDescription: Know what you own, why you bought it, and when that reason broke.
interface.longDescription: Three research workflows in one local plugin. Analyze stocks using daily price indicators and SEC filing fundamentals, with a 50/50 score only when both sides are available. Inspect portfolio exposure and fund overlap using verified N-PORT holdings, with unresolved positions and missing prices clearly identified. Record investment theses and check their cited metrics when you request a scan. Public data comes from Yahoo Finance, Stooq and SEC EDGAR and is cached locally. Charts and journal entries stay in the plugin data directory. No orders, broker credentials or automatic background monitoring. Informational research, not investment advice.
